seo.title: Websites for Healthcare Practices | SynergyFirst Digital
seo.metaDescription: Managed, accessible websites for healthcare and wellness practices — clear credentials, simple appointment paths, patient-friendly design.
seo.ogDescription: Build trust before a patient ever calls, with a clear, accessible, appointment-ready website.

h1: Build trust before a patient ever calls.

sections.subheading: Patients research before they book. Your website is often the first — and most scrutinized — impression of your practice.

sections.heading: Problems we see most often
sections.intro: Common reasons a healthcare website loses patients it should be winning.

items.title: Missing credibility signals
items.body: Credentials, accepted insurance and provider information aren't easy to find.

items.title: No clear way to book
items.body: Appointment requests require a phone call during business hours, with no online option.

items.title: Not accessible
items.body: Small text, low contrast or unlabeled forms shut out patients who need it most.

items.title: Generic, templated design
items.body: A site that doesn't reflect the professionalism of the practice.

sections.heading: How we build your preview
sections.intro: The same free-preview process, shaped around a healthcare practice.

steps.title: Apply
steps.body: Tell us about your practice, specialty and what's not working on your current site (or that you don't have one).

steps.title: We build your preview
steps.body: A private concept site with clear credentials, services and an appointment path.

steps.title: Review for 7 days
steps.body: Explore it privately and tell us what to change. No cost, no obligation.

steps.title: Activate and launch
steps.body: Like it? Choose a plan and we finish, connect your domain, and launch it.

sections.heading: Built for how patients choose a practice

items.title: Simple appointment path
items.body: A clear, low-friction way to request an appointment online.

items.title: Clear provider & service info
items.body: Credentials, specialties and accepted insurance shown up front.

items.title: Accessibility built in
items.body: WCAG 2.2 AA colour contrast and keyboard-friendly navigation as standard, on every site we build.

items.title: Patient-friendly, mobile-first design
items.body: Easy to read and use on any device, for patients of any age.
